items.title: Senseonics Eversense 365 Approved in Europe - World's First One-Year CGM
items.summary: Senseonics receives CE Mark approval for Eversense 365, the only implantable CGM with 365-day sensor life. Launching in Germany, Italy, Spain, and Sweden.
